title: Holder and Companion Entitlements Table for Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
Who travels on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes booking, and what the companion receives on it, is set product by product as follows.

## Who travels

| Term | Certificate Main Cabin | Certificate Main Plus | Certificate Premium Economy | Certificate First | Pass Semiannual | Pass Annual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Companions per reservation using this product | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Holder must travel as the primary traveler | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Companion must be on the same reservation and flights as the holder | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Product may be given to another customer | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Another companion certificate or pass may be used on the same reservation | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Youngest companion age, in years, that may travel without the holder's adult booking rules applying | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Companion's name may be changed on an issued companion ticket beyond a name correction | no | no | no | no | no | no |

## What the companion receives

| Term | Certificate Main Cabin | Certificate Main Plus | Certificate Premium Economy | Certificate First | Pass Semiannual | Pass Annual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Companion ticket earns Summit miles or qualifying dollars | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Companion's first checked bag free regardless of fare brand | no | no | no | yes | no | no |
| Companion receives the same advance seat entitlement as the holder's fare brand | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Companion receives the holder's fare-brand checked bag allowance | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Companion may clear an upgrade with the holder under the holder's Summit companion upgrade entitlement | yes | yes | no | no | yes | yes |
| Holder and companion may make a same-day confirmed change together | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Points of judgement

- One Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product covers at most 1 companion on a reservation, and no second companion product may be added to the same reservation on any product.
- Only the Crestline Companion Certificate First gives the companion a free first checked bag whatever the fare brand; on every product the companion takes the holder's fare-brand seat and bag entitlements.
- The companion upgrade entitlement extends to the companion on the Main Cabin and Main Plus certificates and on both passes, not on the Premium Economy or First certificates.
- **Hypothetical case:** a holder travelling on a Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy booking may make a same-day confirmed change together with the companion; on a Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin booking they may not.
